stem.text: A student sets up apparatus to observe the double-slit interference of monochromatic light, as shown.

stem.alt: Apparatus: an arrow labelled monochromatic light points right at a vertical double slit, labelled double slit, and a vertical screen labelled screen further to the right.

stem.text: Interference fringes are formed on the screen.
Which change would increase the distance between adjacent fringes?

A.text: Decrease the distance between the two slits.

B.text: Decrease the width of each slit.

C.text: Move the screen closer to the double slit.

D.text: Use light of a higher frequency.
